notes: All three conjectures for every k >= 1. A208034_conj1: exp(sum 2 Pell(n)^(2k) x^n/n) has integer coefficients (Gauss congruences: Frobenius in Z[sqrt 2] for odd p via 8 Pell(n)^2 = Q(2n) - 2(-1)^n; 2-adic valuation for p = 2; then Dwork/Euler product). A208034_conj2: x^3 coefficient (4 + 6*2^m + 2*5^m)/3, m = 2k-1, not integral. A208034_conj3: x^2 coefficient (1+4^k)/2. Power-series and Dwork parts copied from OEIS/A207969. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: only the reading of exp(...) as the series fixed by A(0)=1, xA' = (sum b x^n)A.
